title: BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION
de_requirements: Two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes chosen from Economics, Accounts, Business Management, Government, Geography or Statistics.
utme_requirements: Five (5) SSC credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics, plus any two (2) of Accounting, Business Methods, Commerce, Government, Geography, and Statistics.
subjects: Mathematics, Economics and one (1) other subject.
remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)                AAUA accepts ND upper credit in relevant programmes or HND lower credit plus the UTME requirements.

(ii)               AAUA requires 'A' Level pass in Economics or Business Management.

(iii)             ABU accepts  Two â€˜Aâ€™ Level / IJMB passes in Management/Social Science Subjects one of which must be Economics. A Minimum Merit in ABU Diploma in Insurance, Management, Banking or Accounting.

(iv)             FED-KASHERE accepts Two 'Aâ€™ Level credit passes in Economics, Accounting, Management or ND/NCE with credit passes in relevant subjects.

(v)               ABUJA accepts two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Economics, Commerce; NCE or ND at upper credit level or ten (10) points in IJMB in relevant subjects in addition to the 'Oâ€™ Level requirements.

(vi)             ADSU - As in Public Administration.

(vii)            AUN same as in Finance

(viii)          EBSU accepts HND, NCE/ND pass at merit/credit level in relevant programmes in addition to 'O' Level requirements. ND must be at upper credit level.

(ix)             ESUTECH accepts ND in relevant programmes within the Faculty into 200 level in addition to the UTME requirements.

(x)               FED-DUTSINMA accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ level passes in    Economics/Marketing and Mathematics or any Social Sciences subject.   ND/NCE with good grades in Business Management from a recognized institution.

(xi)             JOS accepts ND lower credit, DELSU and BAYERO (upper credit) in relevant programmes.

(xii)            LAGOS requires Very good passes in three (3) JUPEB/â€™Aâ€™ Level subjects: Economics and any two (2) of Financial Accounting, Business Management, Government, Geography and Mathematics.

(xiii)          MCPHERSON accepts

a)       JUPEB/IJMB/ATS (Final) of ICAN or approved equivalent in related programmes.

b)       AIB or other professional qualifications in relevant programmes.

(xiv)          MADONNA, EBSU and COOU accept ND lower credit, AIB and Degree/HND in relevant programmes.

(xv)            NASARAWA accepts HND at lower credit, AIB or other Professional qualifications in relevant programmes or IJMB in relevant subjects not below ten (10) points.

(xvi)          OOU accepts NCE/ND/HND.

(xvii)         OOU, EVANGEL and UYO â€“Same as in Banking and Finance.

(xviii)       PHC accepts Two (2) Advanced level GCE or HSC or JUPEB or IJMB passes in Mathematics and at least one (1) of Economics, Statistics, Accounts including UTME entry requirements.OND (upper credit) or HND (Merit Pass) in Business Education, Business Studies, Business Administration, Marketing, Purchasing and Supply, Office Management, Secretarial Administration, Public Business Studies or Business Studies from any recognised institution, including UTME entry requirements.NCE with at least credit passes in Business Education, Business Studies, Business Administration, Marketing, Purchasing and Supply, Office Management, Secretarial Administration, Public Business Studies or Business Studies from any recognised institution including UTME entry requirements

(xix)          PLASU accepts

a)       degree in any programme provided the candidate meets the 'O' Level requirements

b)       HND lower credit in relevant programmes, with the 'O' Level requirements,

c)       ND lower credit in relevant programmes, with the 'O' Level requirements.

d)       IJMB minimum of seven (7) points with passes in relevant subjects, with the 'O' Level requirements.

e)       PLASU does not accept university diplomas and other diplomas not accredited by the relevant accrediting bodies.

(xx)            RSUST, IGBINEDION, EKSU and BSU - as in Accountancy.

(xxi)          UDU - as applicable to Accounting.

(xxii)         UNIZIK accepts Mathematics but not Geography. Requires applicants to possess the UTME requirements.

(xxiii)       UNN accepts

a)       AIB or other Professional qualifications and HND in relevant programmes.

b)       NCE/ND

(xxiv)       UNN requires two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Economics and any other subject.

(xxv)         UYO accepts HND lower credit, ND upper credit in relevant programmes.

(xxvi)       WELLSPRING accepts ND, NCE, IJMB, NABTEB â€˜Aâ€™ Level, HND passes at credit/lower credit level in relevant subjects/programmes in addition to the â€˜Oâ€™ Level requirements.

(xxvii)      DELSU requires

a)       GCE â€˜Aâ€™ Level or HSC pass in Management, Economics and at least one other    subject.

b)      HND or ND with a grade not lower than upper credit.

c)       Foundation/Intermediate Examination passes of recognized professional       bodies such as Chartered Institute      Management of Nigeria (CIMN),      Chartered Institute Marketing of Nigeria      (CIMN).

  (xxvii)       FED-OYE EKITI requires two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes chosen from Economics, Accounts, Business Management, Government, Geography or Statistics.

 

UTME

(i)              AAUA requires five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and any other two from Commerce, Accounting, Geography, and Government.

(ii)            ABU requires Five â€˜Oâ€™ level credit passes including English Language, Economics, Mathematics and any other two (2) Subjects.

(iii)           ABUJA and COOU accept Commerce In lieu of Economics

(iv)           AUN same as in Finance.

(v)            EBSU and RSUST -Same as in Accountancy.

(vi)           FED-DUTSINMA requires Five â€˜Oâ€™ level Credits to include: English Language, Mathematics Economics/Entrepreneurship/Commerce/Marketing and any two subjects.

(vii)         LAGOS requires â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Economics, and any two (2) of Financial Accounting, Government, Geography, CRS/IS, Business Management.

(viii)        PHC requires Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and any other two (2) subjects from Government/History, Geography, Commerce, Literature in English, CRK/IRK, Accounting (Financial/Business), Biology/Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Physics .

(ix)           PLASU â€“ Same as in Accounting.

(x)            PLASU accepts Commerce or Principles of Accounts In lieu of Economics.

(xi)           UNIZIK accepts a pass in Economics

(xii)         UNIZIK accepts English Language, Mathematics and any three (3) relevant subjects.

DIRECT ENTRY

(i)Â Â Â Â  Â Â Â Â OOU accepts ND/NCE credit in relevant programme.

(ii)Â  Â Â Â Â  BENIN and EKSU accept NCE candidates with credits in &sq;O&sq; Level Mathematics; ND holders must fulfill the UTME requirements.

Â (iii)Â Â Â Â  IAUED requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes/NCE in Computer Science, Mathematics and Physics. IAUED accepts ND/HND credit in Computer Science, Statistics, Information Technology and Electronics/Accounting.

(iv)Â Â  Â Â  EKSU accepts NCE merit in Computer and a pass in General English in lieu of â€˜Oâ€™ Level English Language.

(v)Â Â Â  Â Â  BAUCHI accepts NCE pass with five (5) years teaching experience.

(vi)Â Â Â  LASU accepts â€˜A&sq; Level passes in Mathematics and Physics; or NCE at merit in ComputerÂ Â  Education or Physics and Mathematics; OR Equivalents of the above.

(viÂ Â Â Â  Â  BIU same as in Accountancy

(v) Â Â Â Â Â  BOWEN accepts &sq;A&sq; Level/IJMB/NCE/ND or approved equivalents in Mathematics and Physics. Biology cannot be combined with Agricultural Science

(vi)Â  Â Â Â  TASUED accepts two (2)Â  Â &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics.

(vii)Â Â Â Â  EBSU requires

a)Â Â Â  two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Computer, Mathematics or Integrated Science.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  HND and NCE/OND with minimum of Merit and Upper credit respectively.

(viii)Â  BSU accepts:

(a)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  Preliminary degree candidates (from Benue State University only). Must pass at least five (5) out of the six (6) subjects studies with pass level of at least 50% in each subject.

(b)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  NCE use of English is acceptable in lieu of â€˜Oâ€™ Level in English language.

(c)Â Â Â Â  â€˜Aâ€™ Level pass in any of the acceptable subjects.

(d)Â Â Â Â  IJMB/GCE â€˜Aâ€™ Level or Equivalent in Physics and Mathematics.

(e)Â Â Â Â  ND (Computer science) or Diploma in Computer education at upper credits from a recognized institution.

(f)Â Â Â Â Â  At least a merit in NCE (Computer Education) plus credit in Mathematics or Physics and a credit in English Language at SSC or its equivalent.

(ix)Â Â Â Â  SOSU also accepts Nigeria Certificate in Education (NCE) or Diploma in Science Education with a minimum of merit.

(x)Â Â Â Â  DELSU requires at least merit pass and above in NCE and above in DELSU Diploma in Computer Science Education, Physics Education, Mathematics Education or Chemistry Education.

(x)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ABU accepts Â Merit Pass in Higher Diploma and Diploma in Computer, Statistic or Mathematics Education. NCE with Merit in Education and Computer Science. Two â€˜Aâ€™ Level/IJMB passes in Mathematics and Physics.

(xi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  PHC accepts Â Two (2) A/level GCE or HSC or JUPEB or IJMB passes in the relevant subjects including UTME entry requirements. NCE with Credit passes in the relevant subjects including UTME entry requirements.

(xii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ILORIN accepts;

a)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Nigeria Certificate in Education (NCE) or its equivalent in Computer Science (single or double major) with an overall grade of at least a Merit.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Ordinary National Diploma (OND) in Computer Science with a minimum overall grade of Lower Credit.

c)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Passes at A â€˜Level of G.C.E. or equivalent in Mathematics plus at least one of the following subjects: Physics, Further Mathematics and Chemistry, Computer Studies or Data Processing.

d)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Any three (3) relevant subjects in IJMB and JUPEB.

Â

(i)Â  Â Â Â Â Â  BOWEN and OOU require &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Physics.

(ii) Â Â Â Â Â  IAUED requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in English Language.

(iii)Â Â Â  Â  LAPAI prefers other subjects in the Sciences.

(iv)Â  Â Â Â  PHC require Â Five (5) O Level credits passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry and any other two (2) subjects from Biology, Agricultural Science, Further Mathematics

(v)Â Â Â Â  Â  LASU requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in Physics and Chemistry.

(vi)Â Â Â  Â  BIU require &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in Physics and any other two (2) Science subjects.

(vii)Â Â  Â  DELSU requires five (5) &sq;Oâ€™ Level credit passes which must include English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and any other one subject at not more than two (2) sittings.

(viii) TASUED requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one(1) sitting or six (6) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes at two (2) sittings to include English Language, Mathematics, Physics, and any two (2) or three (3) subjects from Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Geography and Agricultural Science.

(ix)Â Â Â  BSU requires five credits â€˜Oâ€™ Level Passes including: Mathematics, English Language, Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

(x)Â Â  LCITY accepts &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at SSC or its equivalent in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any other two (2) subjects.

(xi)Â Â Â  Credits in English, in the minor subject, and any other two O/Level subjects selected Science Subjects, Computer Studies or Data Processing.

(xiii)Â  SOSU requires Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Physics and two (2) other relevant science subjects at not more than two sittings.

Â

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)Â Â Â Â Â  OAU accepts

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  a. &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and any two (2) from Government, Geography, Mathematics and Statistics

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  b. ND/HND upper credit in Mathematics, Statistics.

(ii)Â Â Â Â  COOUand ESUTECH accept ND with GPA not below 2.50 (on 4.0 scale) NCE, HND and First Degree.

(iii)Â  UDU acceptsND credit in Business Studies and Statistics.

(iv)Â Â Â  IBADAN accepts two (2)&sq;A&sq; Level passes but &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes should include Mathematics and Economics.

(v)Â Â Â Â  EBSU and MAIDUGURI accept ND upper credit/HND upper credit in relevant programmes plus the UTME requirements.

(vi)Â Â Â  OOU accepts ND upper credit in Marketing, General Administration e.t.c. of OOU at least Lower Credit.

(vii)Â Â  BAYERO does not accept Chemistry, Physics, and Agricultural Science and History.

(viii)Â  UNIZIK accepts two (2)&sq;A&sq; Level passes from Economics, Mathematics and Political Science. Direct Entry Applicants must possess the UTME requirements.

(ix)Â Â Â  UNN requires the UTME requirements.

(x)Â Â Â Â  DELSU accepts

a)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  At least two subjects at the Advanced Â Â Â Level which must include Economics.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  DELSU Diploma with merit passes in Â Â Â Â Accounting or Business Administration.

(xi)Â Â Â  EKSU accepts any of the following:

(a)Â Â Â  Five (5)&sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in Mathematics,Economics, English Language and two (2) other subjects one of which must be from the Social Sciences.

(b) Â Â Â  Two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and any of Geography, Government and Mathematics.

(xii)COVENANT accepts ND upper credit in Marketing, Business Administration or Banking and Finance.

(xiii) IGBINEDION accepts ND lower credit in Accounting, Business Administration/ Banking and Finance; NCE in Economics, Mathematics or any other Social Science subject.

(xiv)Â  AL-HIKMAH accepts two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and any other relevant subject.

(xv)Â Â  CUAB requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes to include Mathematics and either Economics or Accounting. Accepts NCE/ND and approved equivalent of at least upper credit in relevant programmes and IJMB at acceptable levels

(xvi)Â  Â Â Â  JOS does not require &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in History and does not accept ND, HND and NCE as entry requirements.

(xvii) Â Â Â  AAUA does not accept Physics, Chemistry or Agricultural Science but accepts NDupper credit and HND lower credit level in relevant programmes.

(xxiv)Â Â Â  UYO accepts ND/HND in relevant programmes plus the UTME requirements.

(xxv) AJAYI accepts &sq;A&sq; Level or equivalents in Economics and one of Accounting, Business Management, Mathematics, Geography and Government.

(xxvi)Â Â Â  Â  BIU same as in Accounting

(xxvii)Â Â  BOWEN - Same as in Accountancy.

(xxviii)Â  UNIOSUN accepts ND upper credit and approved equivalent in Accounting, Business Administration and Banking and Finance.

(xxix)Â Â Â  AUN accepts

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  a. &sq;A&sq; Level passes chosen from Mathematics, Environmental Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Literature in English, Government, History, Economics,Â  Geography, Further Mathematics, Technical Drawing, Visual Arts, Computer Studies, Information Technology, Civics, and French.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  b. Does not accept &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in the following; Agriculture, Food and Nutrition, Home Economics, Home Craft, Home management, Physical Education, Physical and Health Education, Music, Commerce, Accounting, Financial Accounting, Book Keeping, Islamic History, Religious Studies, Tajweed, Library Studies, Diction, Kiswahili, Igbo, Hausa, Yoruba, Arabic, Turkish, Study skills.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  c. Accepts ICGSE and &sq;A&sq; Level Cambridge and does not offer admissions direct to 200 level programs. May transfer credits relevant to its major at the discretion of the Dean of school.

(xxx) CRAWFORDaccepts;

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  Â Â Â  a. Statistics.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  Â Â Â  b. NCE passes in Economics, Mathematics or any Social Science subject.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  c. ND/HND in relevant subjects not lower than lower credit.

(xxxi) Â Â  WESTERN-DEL accepts two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and one other subject.

(xxxii) Â  BELLS â€“ Same as in Accounting.

(xxxiii)Â  Â  AUE accepts NCE upper merit or equivalent in relevant subjects in addition to the UTME requirements.

(xxxiv) DELSU Requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and any one of Geography, Government and Mathematics. Accepts ND upper credit in Business Administration, Accounting, Marketing, Statistics and Banking/Finance. Accepts NCE in Economics.

(xxxv)Â Â  FED-OYE EKITI requires two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Economics, and any one of Mathematics, Statistics, Accounting, Business Management; Government, Geography and Statistics. Or OND in Business Administration, Statistics and Banking and Finance.

(xxxvi)Â  KWASU accepts IJMB Cambridge only.

(xxxvii) RHEMA accepts ND in Economics, Marketing, Business Administration, Banking and Finance, Accounting or NCE in Economics plus the UTME requirements.

(xxxviii)Â  RENAISSANCE accepts NCE, ND/HND or First Degree plus five (5) credit passes at &sq;O&sq; Level subjects other than those passed at &sq;A&sq; Level.

(xxxix)Â Â  FED-OYE EKITI for Criminology and Security Studies requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes chosen from Economics, Accounts, Business Management, Government, Geography or Statistics.

(xl)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  BAYERO does not accept Chemistry, Physics, and Agricultural Science & History.

(xlii)Â Â Â Â Â  NDU accepts

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  a. Two (2)&sq;A&sq; Level passes in Economics and any one of the following: Geography, Statistics, History, Accounting, Business Management.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  b.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ND upper credit or NCE credit relevant to Economics combination

(xliii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  NILE â€“ Same as in Accounting.

(xliv)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  CUAB â€“ Same as in Banking and Finance.

(xlv)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  EBSU accepts HND, NCE and ND merit and upper credit respectively in relevant programmes.

(xlvi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  UMYUK accepts IJMB with a minimum of nine (9) points inÂ Â Â Â  Economics and two (2) other Social Science or Management Science subjects or ND in Accounting, Banking and Finance, Business Administration, Purchasing and Supply Economics/Cooperative with lower credit. NCE in Economics and Mathematics with a minimum of nine (9) points.

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ABUJA accepts a minimum of ten (10) points in NCE merit or ND upper credit in addition to UTME requirements.

(ii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ILORIN accepts:

a)Diploma from Bayero University, Kano satisfies both &sq;A&sq; Level and &sq;O&sq; Level admissions requirements.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Candidates who did not offer Islamic Studies at UTME but meet UTME entry requirements may be considered for admission into 100 level.

c)Candidates with Senior Islamic Studies Certificates as entry qualification for Islamic Studies and related programmes.

(iii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  KWASU -Same as in Arabic.

(iv)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  LASU accepts:

a)at least two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes, including Islamic Studies plus not less than five (5) &sq;O&sq; level credit passes or its equivalent, including English Language at not more than two (2) sittings.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  NCE merit in Islamic Studies and five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in other relevant subjects including English Language.

(v)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  OOU requires UTME requirements in addition to Direct Entry requirements

(vi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  IBADAN accept NCE merit in Islamic Studies and other Arts or Social Science subjects.

(vii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  TSUJ accepts NCE merit in Arabic and Islamic Studies.

(viii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  UMYUK accepts candidates with a minimum of 9 points in IJMB/HSC/GCE â€˜Aâ€™ Level/NCE in Islamic Studies and any other relevant subject. Candidates with a minimum of lower credit pass in Diploma in Islamic Studies, Combined Arabic and Islamic Studies or in Shariâ€™a from recognized institutions may also be admitted.

(ix)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  LAGOS accepts Passes at the GCE A/level or its equivalents. One of the A/level Subjects should be Islamic Studies. NCE with credit or merit inÂ Islamic Studies.

(x)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-KASHERE accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ Level credit passes in Islamic Studies and any other relevant subject or NCE/Dip with credit passes in relevant subjects.

(xi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  KASU accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes including Islamic Studies and one other relevant subject.Â NCE/Senior Islamic Studies Certificate with merit in Islamic Religious Knowledge and other relevant subjects.Â Â IJMB 7 points and above or Lower Credit in National Diploma in addition to â€˜Oâ€™ Level requirements.

(xii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU accepts NCE/Diploma in Arabic and Islamic Studies or Diploma in Shariâ€™ah with a minimum of merit.

(xiii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-DUTSINMA accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ level passes in Islamic Studies and one other Arts Subjects. ND/NCE with good grades in the relevant area.

Â 

UTME

(i)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  AL-HIKMAH requires working knowledge of Arabic.

(ii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  IBADAN accepts five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one sitting or six (6) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at two (2) sittings to include English Language, Islamic Studies and any other three (3) or four (4) subjects from Arts or Social Sciences.

(iii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  KASU requires Five â€˜Oâ€™ level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Islamic Religious Knowledge and two other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences..

(iv)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  KWASU requires five (5) â€˜O&sq; Level credit passes to include English Language, Islamic Studies and any other two (2) Arts subjects.

(v)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  OOU requires two (2) other subjects from Arts.

(vi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  TSUJ accepts Arabic in lieu of Islamic Studies.

(vii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  UMYUK requires five (5) credit passes at SSC, HIS and SIS in English Language, Mathematics, Islamic Studies and any other two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings.

(viii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  LAGOS requires Five Credit passes inÂ English Language, Mathematics, Islamic StudiesÂ and any other two subjects.

(ix)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-KASHERE requires Five credit passes at SSCE (or its equivalent) in English, Mathematics, Islamic Studies and any two of Hausa, Arabic, History, Literature in English, Economics, Government, Civic Education, Commerce.

(x)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU requires Five (5) SSC credit passes to include EnglishÂ  Language, Arabic or Islamic Studies and any other three (3) relevant subjects at not more than two sittings.

(xi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-DUTSINMA requires Five â€˜Oâ€™ level Credits to include: English Language, Mathematics, Islamic Studies and any two of Arts or Social Sciences subjects.

Â 

UTME SUBJECTS

(i)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  IBADAN requires Islamic Studies and any other two (2) subjects from Arts, Sciences or Social Sciences.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

(ii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ILORIN accepts Science/ Social Science subjects.

(iii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  MAIDUGURI requires Islamic Studies/Arabic and any other two (2) subjects.

(iv)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  UMYUK requires Islamic Studies and two (2) other Arts or Social Science subjects.

(v)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  LAGOS requires English Language, Islamic StudiesÂ and any two from Literature in English, History, Government, French, Yoruba, Igbo, Visual Arts, Economics and Commerce.

(vi)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-KASHERE requires IRS and any two of Hausa, Arabic, Government, Economics, Literature in English and History

(vii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  KASU requires Islamic Religious Knowledge and two other subjects in Arts or Social sciences.

(viii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU requires Islamic Studies and any two Arts or Social Science Subjects.

(ix)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  FED-DUTSINMA requires English Language, Islamic Studies and any two subjects of Arts or Social Sciences.

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  GSU, OAU, AAU, BAYERO, BSU and EKSU accept Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry. EKSU does not accept NCE for Direct Entry.

(ii)Â Â Â Â Â Â  RSUST in addition to &sq;O&sq; Level requirements accepts:

Â Â Â  Â (a) HND (Lower Credit) from recognized institutions.

(b) OND/ND (Upper Credit) from recognized institution.

(c) At least two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Mathematics and Physics.

(iii)Â Â Â Â Â  EKSU, OOU and OAU do not accept NCE.

(iv)Â Â Â Â Â  COOU and MAIDUGURI accept ND/HND in relevant programmes.

(v)Â Â Â Â Â Â  BIU accepts ND/NCE upper credit in relevant programme.

(vi)Â Â Â  Â  BENIN accepts DME merit in addition to the UTME requirements.

(vii)Â Â Â Â  BAYERO accepts;

a)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Two â€˜Aâ€™ level passes in Mathematics and any other science subject.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  NCE with at least merit in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry.

c)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Accepts Biology.

d)Â Â Â Â Â Â  It does not accept Economics.

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)      EDLAV does not accept grade less than D7 in Literature in English at 'A' Level or its equivalent.

(ii)     BENIN accepts

          a) two (2) 'A' Level passes plus the UTME requirements, two (2) or three (3) NCe merit including English Language plus three (3) or two (2) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and any of Literature in English, Religious Studies, Fine Arts, French, History or Government at one (1) sitting.

(iii)    OAU accepts two (2)'A' Level passes in relevant subjects including Literature in English. NCE credit or merit in two (2) relevant teaching subjects including Literature in English may be accepted.

 (iv)   JOS and EDALV accept holders of ND.

(v)     UNN, EDALV and IBADAN accept NCE with 'O' Level credit passes in subjects to be combined with Education into 300 level.

(vi)    PHC accepts  Two (2) A/level GCE or HSC or JUPEB or IJMB passes in the relevant subjects including UTME entry requirements.NCE with Credit passes in the relevant subjects including UTME requirements for a 2-year degree programme.

(vii)   BSU requires 'A' Level passes in relevant teaching subjects including Literature in English, NCE with English Language and any other Arts subject.

(viii)  LASU accepts only NCE merit in English Language and one (1) other Arts subject.

(ix)    UMYUK accepts candidates with a minimum of 9 points in IJMB/HSC/GCE â€˜Aâ€™ Level/NCE in English and any other relevant subject. Candidates with a minimum of lower credit pass in Diploma in English Education from recognized institutions may also be admitted.

(x)     BIU requires in addition to the 'O' Level          requirements specified in the table above, two (2) relevant subjects passed at 'A' Level or NCE (3) merits or ND in relevant programme not below credit level.

(xi)    TASUED accepts NCE merit in two (2) teaching subjects including Literature in English not General English provided that they meet the basic 'O' Level requirements.

(xii)  UNIOSUN accepts two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes to include English Language.

(v)     EBSU accepts

(i)       HND and NCE/OND with minimum of Merit and Upper credit respectively.

(ii)     two (2) 'A' Level passes in English Language, and Literature in English.

(xiv)  EDKANO - Candidates must obtain not less than eight (8) points in NCE.

(xv)   LAGOS accepts

(a)        Very good passes in three (3) JUPEB subjects: Literature in English, and any two (2) of French, Igbo, Yoruba, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Government, Economics and Arabic.

(b)        Two (2) 'A' Level passes in English Language and Literature in English.

(c)        NCE: English Language, Literature in English, Mathematics and any other two (2) subjects.

(d)     Candidates must also satisfy the UTME requirements

(xvi)  AAUA accepts

(a)        'A' Level passes to include English Language and one (1) relevant subject.

(b)        Two (2) merit in NCE teaching subjects.

(xvi)    DELSU requires at least merit in English and any other Arts subject at the NCE. 'Aâ€™ Level passes should include Literature in English and at least one other Arts subject.

(xvii)  UYO requires;

a)       NCE in relevant subject(s) with an overall merit pass or above, for a three-year degree programme.

b)       Advanced level GCE or JUPEB in two (2) relevant subjects.

c)       National Diploma in Educational Technology (DET) (minimum of lower credit level) in any area related to English Education.

(xviii)          ILORIN accepts NCE in two (2) relevant subjects including English Language.  Two A/L Passes in English Language and Literature in English.

(xix) IAUED accepts GCE A Level or its equivalent. Merit in English (NCE) and UTME Requirements. Merit at the National Diploma (ND). The above including the following â€˜Oâ€™ level credits in English Language, Mathematics, Literature (Compulsory), History and Christian Religious Studies (any other arts subject).

(xx)  LAGOS accepts  NCE credit/merit in English, Literature-in-English, Mathematics and any two subjects. Very good passes in three JUPEB subjects: Literature-in-English and any two of French, Igbo/Yoruba, History, CRS/IRS, Government, Economics and Arabic. Three â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in relevant teaching subject areas.

(xxi)  FED-KASHERE accepts Two 'A' Level credit passes in relevant subjects or ND/NCE/Diploma with minimum of 9 points.

(xxii)FED-DUTSINMA accepts Same as in BA ENGLISH

 

UTME

(i)           DELSU accepts 'Oâ€™ Level credit in at least five subjects including English Language, Mathematics, English Literature and one other Arts subjects.

(ii)           IMSU requires 'O' Level credit passes in Literature in English and other Arts subjects.

(iii)          OAU requires five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes which should include English Language and Literature in English plus 'O' Level credit passes in any three (3) other subjects or credit/merit in five (5) TC II subjects relevant to the course of study may be accepted.

(iv)          BSU accepts credit/merit at TC II in relevant subjects.

(v)           BENIN requires five (5)'O' Level credit passes to include English Language and other subjects from Literature in English, History, French, Fine Arts, Government and Religious Studies.

(vi)          UMYUK requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and any other three (3) relevant subjects in Arts or Social Sciences with 'O' Level credit pass in Mathematics.

(vii)        TASUED requires five (5)'O' Level credit passes at one (1) sitting or six (6) 'O' Level credit passes at two (2) sittings to include Literature in English, English Language and one (1) other Arts subject.

(viii)       ABSU requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) subjects.

(ix)          UNIOSUN accepts 'O' Level or its equivalents with credit passes in five (5) subjects: English Language, Mathematics and Literature in English form the core subjects, with credit passes in two (2) other relevant Arts or Social Sciences subject at not more than two (2) sittings. The candidate must earn an acceptable score in the UTME

(x)           LASU requires 'O' Level credit pass in Mathematics.

(xi)          ABUJA and EBSU require five (5) `O` level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Literature in English and two (2) other Arts subjects.

(xii)        GOUU requires 'O' Level credit pass in Mathematics but Literature in English is not compulsory.

(xiii)       LAGOS requires  Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Literature-in-English and any two subjects from Arts, Science and Social Sciences.

(xiv)       EDKANO requires 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Islamic Studies/Arabic and two (2) Arts subjects.

(xv)        SLUK accepts five (5) 'O' Level Credit passes to include English and two (2) other subjects from History, Government, Geography, French, Arabic, Hausa, Islamic Studies and Economics.

(xvi)       AAUA requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Literature in English, Mathematics and   any two (2) of the following: CRS/IRS, Igbo Language/Yoruba Language/Hausa Language, and History, Government, French, Fine Arts or Music.

(xvii)     UYO requires  at least five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level Credits, including English Language, Mathematics, Literature in English, Government, and any other two (2) Social Science subjects or Information Science.

(xviii)    ILORIN accepts five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Literature-in-English and one Arts Subject obtained through GCE/SSCE/NECO/ NABTEB.

(xix)       IAUED requires â€˜Oâ€™ Level credits in English Language, Mathematics, Literature (Compulsory), History, Christian Religious Studies (any other Arts subject).

(xx)         PHC requires Five (5) O Level Credits in English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) subjects from French, History/Government, CRK/IRK, Economics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Further Mathematics, Technical Drawing, Physics, Igbo/Hausa/Yoruba, Fine Art, Geography, Commerce, Accounting.

(xxi)        FED-KASHERE requires Five credit passes at SSCE (or its equivalent) in English, Mathematics and Literature in English and other two (2) from Arts or Social Science Subjects.

(xxii)      FED-DUTSINMA  Same as in BA ENGLISH

 

 

UTME SUBJECTS

(i)        EBSU and OOU require Literature in English and two (2) Arts subject.

(ii)       For BENIN the third (3rd) subject could also be an Arts or a Social Science subject.

(iii)      AAUA requires Literature in English and two (2) other Arts subjects.

(i) CALABAR requires three (3) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any one of Economics, Mathematics and Geography. History not acceptable in lieu of Government but accepts IJMB.

Â a. ND/HND upper credit in Public Administration and Local Government Â Studies

b. &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any two (2) from Economics, Geography, Christian Religious Studies, Mathematics, History.

(xiv) UNN accepts NDÂ in Public Administration at merit level plus the UTME requirements.

(xvi) ABU accepts three (3) &sq;A&sq; Level/IJMB passes from any of the following subjects: Government, History, Sociology, Economics, Geography.

(xxi) GOUU requires three (3) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any one of Economics, Mathematics and Geography. IJMB

Â (xxiii) NDU accepts

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â a. two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any one of the following: Economics, History or Geography.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â b. NCE credit in Political Science and in combination or Local Government Administration with credit passes.

(xxiv) SOUTHWESTERN accepts IJMB/NCE/ND/HND or its equivalents.

(xxv) BOWEN requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any one of Economics, Geography, Mathematics or History.

(xxvi) ODUDUWA accepts NCE with merit passes in relevant subjects.

(xxvii) FED-DUTSINMA accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ level Passes in Political Science/Government/History and any relevant Social Science or Arts subject or Diploma in Personnel or Administration with Lower Credit.

(xxviii) PLASU accepts

a)Â degree in any programme provided the candidate meets UTME requirements

b)Â HND minimum of lower credit in relevant programme, with UTME requirements,

c)Â ND minimum of lower credit in relevant programme, with UTME requirements.

d)Â IJMB minimum of seven (7) points with passes in relevant subjects, plus UTME requirements.

e)Â PLASU does not accept university diplomas and other diplomas not accredited by the relevant accrediting bodies.

(xxix)Â UNIKINGS requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and one other Social Science subject.

(xxx)Â UMYUK accepts candidates with a minimum of 9 points in IJMB/HSC/GCE â€˜Aâ€™ Level/NCE in Government or History or Civic Education and any other Social Science subject.

e)Â B.Sc. in related discipline with minimum of Second Class Lower.

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i) MAIDUGURI and UYO accept ND/HND with good grades in relevant programmes.

(ii) UYO requires HND/ND in relevant programmes with the UTME requirements.

(iii) Â PHC - No direct entry.

Â Â Â Â (iv) BENIN accepts ND upper credit/HND lower credit in Public Administration or Mass Communication NCE merit with credit passes in Government/History and any other Social Science subject. Direct Entry candidates must satisfy the UTME requirements.

(v) Â Â Â Â UNIOSUN in addition to the UTME requirements accepts &sq;A&sq; Level passes in History, Literature in English and Mathematics.

(vi) Â Â  CRAWFORD accepts

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â a. two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Government and any other Social Science subject.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â b. NCE - with at least merit.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â c. ND/HND in relevant programmes not lower than lower Â Â credit.

(vii)Â WESTERN-DEL accepts at least two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in any one of the following subjects: Government, History, Economics or Geography.

(viii) TSUJ in addition to UTME requirements accepts

a. IJMB (Arts and Social Sciences)

b. NDÂ lower credit in Public Administration to be placed in 100 level while upper credit in 200 level.

(ix) NILE accepts any two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects, ND/HND lower credit or NCE merit in relevant programmes or subjects.

(x) CUAB â€“ Same as in Mass Communication.

(xi) ABUJA accepts two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. Or NCE (minimum10 points) /ND upper credit in Social Works and other relevant programme in Â Â addition to the UTME requirements.

(xii)Â ABUAD accepts A&sq; level passes in at least two subjects. National Diploma in any relevant courses from recognized institution.

(xiii)Â PHC accepts Â Two (2) Advanced level passes in GCE or HSC or JUPEB or IJMB, one of which must be Government or History in addition to the UTMEÂ  entry requirements.

(xiv)Â EUI accepts Â Two A` level passes including government or history and one social science subject in addition to UTME requirements. ND/HND with credit passes in relevant field. NCE with a minimum of Merit in any related Arts/Social/Management Science. A good pass in JUPEB/IJMB Subjects. A university degree in a related discipline.

Â 

Â 

UTME

(i) UYO requires at least &sq;O&sq; Level pass in Mathematics.

(ii) PHC requires Â Five (5) SSC credit passes including English Language, Government or History, Economics and any other two (2) subjects fromÂ Geography, Commerce, Literature in English, Mathematics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Agricultural Science. NoteÂ Pass in Mathematics is compulsory, if Mathematics is not inclusive in the five credits.

(iii) Â  BENIN require &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, History/Government and Mathematics.

(iv) GOUU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings in subjects which include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and Government.

(v) UNIOSUN requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes obtained at not more than one sitting in English Language, Government and Mathematics and any other two (2) relevant subjects.

(vi) CRAWFORD requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes to include English Language, Government and three (3) other subjects with at least a pass in Mathematics.

(vii)Â WESTERN-DEL requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Government and one other Social Science subject and other subject of choice.

(viii)Â TSUJ requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, History/Government, Mathematics and any two (2) or three (3) if Mathematics is not passed at credit level to include Economics, Geography, Christian Religious StudiesÂ /Islamic Studies, Commerce and Literature in English.

(ix)Â NDA requires &sq;O&sq; LevelÂ credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Government and any other two (2) of Economics, History, Geography, French, Literature in English, Christian Religious StudiesÂ /Â Islamic StudiesÂ and any Nigerian Language.

(x)Â CUAB requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes or equivalents which must include English Language, Â Mathematics, and any other three (3) subjects as may be specified by each Faculty.

(xi)Â  ABUJA requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes to include English Language, Government and Mathematics.

(xii)Â FED-OYE EKITI requiresÂ five (5) SSC credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Government and any two (2) from Social Sciences, Science or Arts subjects.

(xiii)Â ABUAD requires Five (5) SSC credit passes including English Language and any combination of three (3) subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Science.

(xiv)Â EUI requires Â Five credit passes in SSCE or its equivalent in English language, Mathematics, Government or History and any other two Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings.

Â 

UTME Â SUBJECTS

(i) BENIN and EBSU accept Government or History, one other Social Science subject and any other subject.

(ii) UYO requires Government or Economics and any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects.

(iii) Â Â PHC requires Â Economics, Government/HistoryÂ and any other Social Science, Arts SubjectÂ Â or Mathematics.

(iv) Â Â  CRAWFORD requires Mathematics, Government and any Social Science subject or History.

(v)Â CUAB and TSUJ require History or Government and any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects.

(vi)Â NILE accepts Government/History/Civic Education and any two (2) Arts or Social Sciences subjects.

(vii)Â ABUJA requires Government and any other two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects.

(viii)Â ABUAD requires Three (3) Arts, Social Science or Science subjects.

(ix)Â EUI requires three Arts or social science subjects.

remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)Â Â Â Â Â  IBADAN - Same as in Adult Education.

(ii)Â Â Â Â  PHC - No Direct Entry.

(iii)Â Â Â  TASUED requires &sq;A&sq; Level passes/NCE merit in relevant teaching subjects. Also accepts ND/HND with upper credit.

(i)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  ILORIN accepts two (2) â€œAâ€ Level Passes in GCE/IJMB/Equivalent to include at least one teaching subject in Art/Social Sciences/Science.Â  Preference is given to NCE holders.

(ii)Â Â Â Â Â Â  LASU requires two (2) &sq;A&sq; Level passes or NCE merit to include the candidateâ€™s teaching subject. The teaching subjects are Economics, Geography, Political Science or Government, Business Administration or Business Studies and Accounting. Does not accept ND or HND.

(iii)Â Â Â Â Â  BSU accepts NCE with five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes or their equivalents including a credit in Mathematics and English Language OR lower credit in a relevant ND programme provided the UTME requirements are met.

(iv)Â Â Â Â Â  NDU â€“ Same as Vocational and Technical Education.

(v)Â Â Â Â Â Â  AAUA requires three (3) NCE merit in Education and two teaching subjects.

(vi)Â Â Â Â Â  IAUED accepts Nigerian Certificates in Educational (NCE) or National Diploma (ND) Qualification with not below merit including credit in Mathematics and English and any three (3) subjects chosen fromÂ Social Sciences or Arts.

(vii)Â Â Â  EKSU accepts NCE with a minimum of two passes or merit in addition to O &sq; level requirements. A pass in General English at NCE level is accepted in lieu of required credit pass in English Language at O &sq;level. Two A level Passes in relevant subjects in addition to O level requirements. OND Certificate or Diploma Certificate from a recognized University.

(viii)Â Â  RSUST accepts Admissions into Year II; NCE/OND/ND (Upper Credit) in relevant discipline. HND/First Degree in relevant discipline. In addition, all such candidates above must also satisfy the UME entry requirements.

(ix)Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU accepts A minimum of Merit in N.C.E

Â 

Â 

Â 

UTME

(i)Â Â Â  TASUED requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one (1) sitting or six (6) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at two (2) sittings including English Language, Mathematics, Economics and other subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

(ii)Â Â  IBADAN requires five(5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one (1) sitting to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and other subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

(i)Â Â Â Â Â  ABSU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Economics and &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in the subject of study, the options.

(iv)Â  AAUA requires five â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and any other two subjects.

(ii)Â Â Â  ILORIN accepts Â five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credits in GCE/SSCE/NECO/ TCII/ Equivalent, to include English Language, Mathematics, and any three other Arts/Social Science/ Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings.

(iii)Â Â  LASU requires a credit pass in the candidateâ€™s teaching subject. The teaching subjects are Economics, Geography, Political Science Government, Business Administration or Business Studies and Accounting.

(iv)Â Â  BSU accepts GR II Teachers Certificate with credit/merit in five (5) subjects including English Language and Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings.

(v)Â Â Â  IAUED requires five (5) 0â€™ Level credits including English Language and Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings in SSCE, GCE, NECO and NABTEB.

(vi)Â Â  EKSU: Candidates must possess at least five credit passes at not more than two sittings which must include English, Mathematics and Economics/Commerce. n addition to the general requirements, candidates applying for EMT/Geography must have O&sq;level credit pass in Geography.

(vii) RSUST requires Five (5) WASC/SSCE/ GCE/NECO NABTEB â€˜Oâ€™ Level Credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics/Commerce, Accounting or any other relevant subject.

(viii)Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU requires Five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any other three subjects at not more than two sittings.

Â 

Â 

UTME SUBJECTS

(i)Â  TASUED - Mathematics, Government and any other relevant subject from Arts and Social Science or Science.

(ii) IBADAN requires English Language, the subject of specialisation and one (1) each from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

(iii)Â  NDU accepts Social Sciences subjects.

(iv)Â  LASU requires candidates&sq; teaching subject or any other subject where the candidates&sq; teaching subject is Economics.

(v)Â Â  BENIN accepts for

a.Â Â Â Â  Management Economics: Economics, Mathematics and one other Social Sciences/Arts Subject.

b.Â Â Â  Management Political Science and Public Administration: Government or History, one (1) Social Science subject and any other subject.

(vi)Â Â  UNIZIK accepts any three (3) subjects.

(vii)Â  ILORIN requires English and any three (3) others in Art/Social Sciences/Science subjects.

(viii)IAUED requires Â English, Government, Economics, Christian Religious Studies or Commerce

(ix)Â Â  EKSU requires Economics, Mathematics and one (1) other Social Science/Arts subject.

(x)Â Â Â Â  RSUST requires Â English Language, and any three relevant subjects in Arts, Science and Social Science.

(xi)Â Â Â  SOSU requires Any three (3) Subjects.

(i)Â Â Â Â Â  IBADAN - Same as Adult Education. IBADAN requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Mathematics for all Science based combination and Economics, while &sq;O&sq; Level pass in Mathematics is required for other Social Science courses. &sq;A&sq; Level/NCE requirement should be in the teaching subjects available at UI.

(ii)Â Â Â Â  OOU and UNN accept TC I and ACE.

(iii)Â Â Â  EDALV accepts NCE credit in Education Theory/Guidance and Counseling to do the two (2) year programme.

(iv)Â  LAGOS requires Â Very good passes in three JUPEB subjects: Literature in English, Economics, CRS/IRS, Government, History, Igbo, Yoruba, French and Geography. ThreeÂ â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in Literature in English, Economics, CRS/IRS, Government, History, Igbo, Yoruba, French and Geography. NCE â€“ Any two of Literature in English, Economics, CRS/IRS, Government, History, Igbo, Yoruba, French and Geography.

Â (v)Â Â Â  TASUED same as in Educational Management

(vi)Â Â Â  UNN accepts any of the following for a three (3)-year Degree Programme (Professional)

(a)Â  Â Â  NCE/ACE merit or above in two (2) relevant subjects.

(b)Â  Â  Certificate in Nursing and Midwifery [NRN, SRN, NRM] recognized by the University for the purpose of Direct Entry admissions with merit.

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  For a three (3)-year Direct Entry Degree Programme with a teaching subject in the following programme, candidate must satisfy the UTME requirement.

(a)Â  Guidance and Counseling combined with a science teaching subject Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Integrated Science.

(b) Â Â  Guidance and Counseling combined with a Social Science Teaching subject; Social Studies, Economics, Geography, and Political Science.

(c)Â  Guidance and Counseling combination with an Arts Teaching subject; English Language, French, Music, Igbo Linguistics, History, Religious Studies, Fine and Applied Arts.

(vii)Â Â  ILORIN accepts;

a)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Two (2) passes at the Principal or Advanced Level with G.C.E. &sq;O&sq; level or approved equivalent Credit passes in three other subjects at not more than two (2) sittings.

b)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Three (3) passes at the Principal or Advanced level with G.C.E. &sq;O&sq; level or approved equivalent credit passes in two other subjects at not more than two sittings; (passes at the Principal or Advanced level may be obtained at the G.C.E. &sq;A&sq; level, H.S.C. or IJMB).

c)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Passes in two recognized NCE subjects with GCE &sq;O&sq; level credits or equivalent in three other subjects. Education is accepted as a third &sq;A&sq; level subject for those taking courses in Education.

(viii)Â  EKSU accepts â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes or NCE in two (2) subjects plus the UTME requirements.

(ix)Â Â  DELSU accepts five â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes at SSC or its equivalent and at least merit passes in not less than two (2) subjects, at the GCE &sq;A&sq; Level or NCE.

(x)Â Â Â Â  IAUED A pass at merit levels in relevant, Diploma programme provided the requirements of English and Mathematics have been met from a recognized institution. National certificate in Education (NCE) in subjects relevant at the subject at merit or credits levels. International Baccalaureates, Interim Joint Matriculation Board (ITMB) with at least two â€˜Aâ€™ level passes in any subject and pre-requites number of â€˜Oâ€™ level credits passes.

(xi)Â Â Â  BSU requires NCE passes in relevant subjects with &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes/TC II merit in three (3) other subjects and Guidance and Counseling, &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Mathematics or lower credit in relevant ND programme from any recognised institution of higher learning provided the UTME requirements are met.

(i)Â Â Â Â  NDU â€“ Same as Vocational and Technical Education.

(ii)Â Â Â Â  ABU accepts ABU Diploma in Guidance and Counseling with Minimum of Merit. NCE with Merit in Education â€˜Câ€™ in one the combination. Two â€˜Aâ€™ Level/IJMB passes in any two Subjects.

(iii)Â Â Â  FED-KASHERE accepts Two Aâ€™ Level credit passes in relevant teaching subjects of specialization. NCE/Diploma with credit or merit passes in two relevant subjects..

(iv)Â Â Â  SOSU accepts A minimum of Merit in Nigeria Certificate in Education (NCE).

(v)Â Â Â Â  FED-DUTSINMA accepts Two â€˜Aâ€™ level passes in Guidance and Counseling or from Arts and Social Science subjects from a recognized institution. ND/NCE not below lower credit or nine (9) points in the relevant area.

Â

UTME

(i)Â Â Â Â Â  EDALV - No admission through the UTME.

(ii)Â Â Â Â  ABUJA, EBSU, TASUED and LAGOS require &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in two (2) Arts/Science subjects in addition to English Language and Mathematics.

(iii)Â Â Â  DELSU requires five â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and any other three (3) from Arts/Social Science/Science subjects.

(iv)Â Â Â  LAGOS requires Â Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and three of Literature in English Language, History, Government, Geography, Economics, Igbo/Yoruba, CRS/IRS, French and Civic Education.

(v)Â Â Â Â  NOCOEN conducts practical examination for UTME candidates.

(vi)Â Â Â  IMSU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, Biology, one (1) Science subject and two (2) others.

(vii)Â Â  TASUED requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one (1) sitting or six (6) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at two (2) sittings to include English Language, Biology and other subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences. &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Mathematics is compulsory for those with teaching subject options in Science and Social Sciences.

(viii)Â  IBADAN requires five (5) â€˜O&sq; Level credit passes at one (1) sitting including English Language, Biology and three (3) other Arts/Social Science subjects.

(ix)Â Â Â  ILORIN requires Credit passes in English Language and Mathematics, and 3 other subjects at &sq;O&sq; Level (WASC/GCE) or approved equivalent at not more than two (2) sittings.

(x) Â Â Â  PHC requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Mathematics.

(xi)Â Â  UNN accepts with Teaching subject for four (4)-year Degree programme

(a) Â Â Â  the Universityâ€™s requirements plus credit pass in &sq;O&sq; Level/TC II in Teaching subject to be combined.

(b)Â  Â  Additional requirements for specific subject combination include:

(1)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Guidance and Counseling combined with a Science Teaching subject; Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Integrated Science - As in Education/Science.

(2)Â Â Â Â Â Â  Guidance and Counseling combined with Social Science Teaching subject; Social Studies, Economics, Geography, Political Science â€“ As in Education/Social Science.

(3)Â Â Â  Guidance and Counseling combined with Arts Teaching subject; English Language, French, Music, Igbo Linguistics, History, Religious studies, Fine and Applied Arts â€“ As in Education/Arts.

(x)Â Â Â Â  Â Â Â Â Â  NDU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Biology and any other two (2) subjects.

(xii)Â Â  IAUED: Must have five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ level passes at credit level in WAEC/NECO/NABTEB/ Teachers Grade II (TC II) examinations or its equivalent at not more than two sittings. The Five credits include Mathematics, English and 3 other subjects

(xiii)Â  BSU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes to include English Language and &sq;O&sq; Level pass in Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings.

(xiv)Â  NDU requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Biology and any other two (2) subjects at not more than two (2) sittings.

(xv)Â Â Â Â  AAUA requires five (5) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics and three (3) other subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

(xvi)Â Â Â  LCITY requires five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes at SSC or its equivalent to include English Language, Mathematics and any other three (3) subjects.

(xvii)Â  EKSU requires five (5) â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes which must include English Language, Mathematics

(xviii) ABU accepts Â Five â€˜Oâ€™ level credit passes in Arts & Social Sciences including English Language and Mathematics.TC II with Five Credit including English Language with at least a pass in Mathematics.

(xix)Â Â Â Â  FED-KASHERE requires Five credit passes at SSCE (or its equivalent) in English, Mathematics, Biology and any other two subjects.

(xx)Â Â Â Â Â  SOSU requires Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics and any other three subjects at not more than two sittings.

(xxi)Â Â Â Â  FED-DUTSINMA requires Â Five â€˜Oâ€™ level Credits to include English Language, Mathematics andÂ  any three of Arts, Social Sciences or Science subjects.

OND with (Upper Credit) or HND with Merit Pass in the relevant subjects including UTME entry requirements from recognized Institutions of higher learning.
